verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's built-in Automations scheduler persists jobs, wakes the agent at the right time, and delivers output to a chat channel, a webhook, or nowhere. It also supports webhook and Gmail PubSub triggers, standing orders that give the agent permanent operating authority for autonomous programs, and background sub-agent runs. A community user separately reports scheduling tasks across multiple agents on one machine. Missing for 10: in-depth independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably scheduled jobs run unattended over time.
